description: Somos un equipo de chicas del Colegio North School de Punta del Este que nos interesa mucho estos temas y tratar de solucionar algunos problemas. Sabemos programar en entornos para nuestra edad.
summary: We built a spaceship; upon entering, you can see the ship’s control panel, and the window displays a simulation of the journey.
details: The idea is to show in a video how they can operate the spacecraft and what they can see from its windows.
